item.title: Version 0.1.5
item.description:
What's New

  • Transcribe audio files and recordings. A new Transcribe tab in Settings lets you record yourself or import an audio file (WAV, MP3, M4A, AIFF, CAF) and copy the full transcription. Open it from the menu bar with "Transcribe Audio...".
  • Parakeet Ultra replaces Parakeet v3. Same speed, more accurate in all 25 languages. If you were using Parakeet v3, Sotto switches you to Ultra automatically and downloads it on first launch (~630 MB). The old v3 files are removed.
  • New models. Phonon-2, the fastest English model yet (~360 MB). Qwen3 ASR and Qwen3 ASR Large for 52 languages, including strong Chinese, Japanese and Korean. SenseVoice for Chinese, Cantonese, Japanese and Korean.
  • Microphone permission fixes. The "Microphone access required" banner now goes away as soon as access is granted, including when you allow it in System Settings. If macOS won't show the prompt again, "Grant Access" opens the Microphone pane in System Settings instead of doing nothing.
  • Better VoiceOver support in the Transcribe tab: headings, a spoken recording timer, and announcements when a transcription finishes or fails.

Upgrade

item.title: Version 0.1.4
item.description:
What's New

  • Continuity microphone fallback. When no usable microphone is available (MacBook clamshell with no headset, or a desktop Mac with no input connected), Sotto now routes recording to a paired iPhone via Continuity Capture. Enabled by default; toggle in Settings → General → Microphone.
  • Input device picker now actually routes capture. Picking a specific microphone in Settings → General → Microphone now sends recording to that device instead of always using the system default.

item.title: Version 0.1.3
item.description:
What's Fixed

  • Real download progress for Parakeet. The progress bar used to sit at 10% for the whole download and then jump straight to "Loading", which made it look stuck. It now climbs from 0% to 100% as the model actually downloads.
  • Automatic recovery from corrupted model files. If a model fails to load (CoreML errors like "Unable to load model", "Error in reading the MIL network", or "Compile the model…"), Sotto now wipes the broken files automatically. Just click Download again and you'll get a fresh, working copy — no more being stuck in an error loop.

item.title: Version 0.1.2
item.description:
What's Fixed

  • Stuck model downloads. Some users got permanently stuck on first launch when picking the Parakeet model — the download would hang forever, no way to cancel it, and reinstalling the app didn't help because the partially-downloaded files survived on disk and re-triggered the hang.
  • Added a Cancel button while a model is downloading or loading.
  • You can now pick a different model mid-download instead of being locked out.
  • Cancelling a stuck download cleans up the partial cache, so the next attempt starts fresh — and a relaunch won't auto-restore a broken model.

item.title: Version 0.1.1
item.description:
Sotto 0.1.1

  • New: Vocabulary keywords for Whisper — add words the model often gets wrong (names, brands, technical terms), separated by commas, in General settings
  • Translation is much more reliable — harder to confuse the model into refusing, echoing the source, or answering questions instead of translating
  • Loading indicator now appears in the pill and notch while transcription is processing
  • Whisper downloads no longer appear stuck at 100% — the model prewarm phase has its own status
  • Deleting a non-active model in the Models tab updates immediately

Sotto 0.1.0
